title: 2018–2026 全市場TDCC-法人-融資群體先後順序｜獨立續篇
research_question: Do observed TDCC large-holder structural changes temporally precede or lag aggregate institutional trades and margin changes in a repeated, non-accounting-only pattern, beyond common date/liquidity composition? Not psychological causality or alpha.
null_hypotheses: H0a: across stocks, earlier aggregate-group behavior has no association with later other-group behavior after week/size-conditioned shuffle
H0b: any observed lag association has no advantage over the reverse direction for the same holder-flow pairing, suggesting persistence/mechanical accounting rather than ordering
H0c: apparent groups are driven by common market/sector information or stock ownership accounting and do not replicate by calendar year

sample_constraints.market: TWSE-listed-appearing-four-digit non-obvious-DR per reference-week actual source row; not a complete PIT ordinary-share legal roster
sample_constraints.main_universe: all qualifying market candidates; non-defensive subgroups cannot be asserted without historical industry classification
sample_constraints.historical_identity_conflicts: all analyses repeated excluding current-roster date-conflict-flagged observations; if result depends on them => fail or only descriptive
sample_constraints.missingness: missing source values retain NULL and flag; no imputation of finance/TDCC to zero, no forward filling of TDCC days
sample_constraints.stock_time_episode: Ticker × fixed globally anchored NONOVERLAPPING time block; statistical independent unit is calendar anchor, NOT each stock-week
sample_constraints.provenance_between_sources: SourceKind retained; stock runs crossing source changes are separately sensitivity-marked; no claim vendor retrieval date equals original TDCC publication date

time_alignment.weekly_index: sorted global TDCC SnapshotDate unique reference weeks; T is weekly index within separate discovery/replication/stress phase
time_alignment.anchor_rule: For weekly horizon L select anchor indexes T=L, L+2L, L+4L etc while T+L < phase week count. Previous and future weekly blocks [T-L,T] and [T,T+L] share boundary only; no event overlap between consecutive anchors.
time_alignment.trading_session_calendar: sorted unique TWSE Date; daily institutional previous N sessions are <= weekly reference date, next N sessions are > weekly reference date; weekends/special Saturday trading days follow historical TWSE calendar, not guessed weekdays
time_alignment.window_stock_coverage: for each stock each institutional window requires >=80% (ceil(0.8*N)) of global TWSE market days with valid positive Volume and relevant net flow; no missing cell imputed; disclose surviving stocks/anchors
time_alignment.margin_window_requirements: for margin changes require valid >=0 baseline and terminal balance on corresponding observed trade days, not cash flow or identifiable investor
time_alignment.tdcc_endpoint_requirement: TDCC valid tier at all required weekly endpoints, no cross-week smoothing/interpolation, source-change boundaries flagged

phase_boundaries.prospective: only newly observed releases after 2026-11-07 can ever qualify, separate post-registered process

institution_margin_vector: sum(ForeignNet)/sum(Volume) over N global TWSE trading sessions
sum(TrustNet)/sum(Volume) over N global TWSE trading sessions
sum(DealerNet)/sum(Volume) over N global TWSE trading sessions
variables.comparisons: 4×4=16 fixed pairings per direction/horizon. First principal discovery statistic uses max absolute across all sixteen with max-statistic permutation correction (no posthoc selection without correction).
variables.persistence_accounting_caveat: TDCC large-holder cohorts and institutional holdings may be the same owners; large/small proportions mathematically sum to total; no same-window mechanical association is allowed as a new behavioral law.
variables.price_usage: Historical price, turnover, and market-week common conditions ONLY; no future stock return or target optimization in G3 or G4.

testing_design.anchor_cross_section: At each nonoverlapping weekly anchor, Spearman rho across eligible stocks for all 16 predeclared TDCC-flow/margin variable pairings; exclude pair at anchor with <100 eligible stocks.
testing_design.aggregate_stat: For each of sixteen pairs average anchor-wise rho equally across eligible anchors; main study statistic T=max(abs(mean_rho(pair))) among 16. Deterministic tie-break lexical variable order.
testing_design.null: Within same anchor, permute the whole future-side multivariate outcome vector over ticker identities within quintiles of trailing-20-market-session median Turnover (quintiles determined separately in each anchor from its prior information). Preserve TDCC/finance co-dependence within group vectors. Do not shuffle fields individually.
testing_design.p_value: (1+# null values >= observed T)/(999+1). Holm step-down across all 6 registered primary tests, familywise 0.05.
testing_design.effect_size_qualification: Selected max-pair |average anchor rho| >=0.08 AND at least 4 out of 5 discovery years have matching selected-pair sign AND Holm adjusted p<0.05.
testing_design.directional_asymmetry: Same selected pair across both directions at same horizon: effect abs(mean_rho_this_direction) - abs(mean_rho_opposite_direction) >= 0.05 required for any 'leads' language; otherwise both directions may be descriptive persistent co-movement only.
testing_design.bootstrap: Across nonoverlapping weekly anchors; do not bootstrap each stock-week as an independent human or each TDCC row as a separate event.
testing_design.sector_common_information: No historical PIT sector data certified; not allowed to claim market/industry-factor adjusted independence; industry effects and self-overlap explicitly remain unresolved, even with week and size-stratified controls.
testing_design.mechanism_upgrade: Never assert independent actor interaction, intention, causality or smart money from these associations; only observational temporal correlation.

minimum_evidence.24week_constraint: Expected discovery 5 and 2023-24 replication 2 nonoverlapping anchors from calendar only. Therefore both 24w experiments are preclassified UNDERPOWERED_FOR_CONFIRMATION and may only supply non-inferential descriptive coverage, even if many stocks appear per anchor. No parameter retuning to rescue.
minimum_evidence.cross_year_replication: Selected discovery pair and direction fixed without revising nulls; 2023 and 2024 each separately same sign, annual |rho|>=0.05 and reverse-direction superiority threshold if leadership claimed.

data_snooping: Historical datasets and A1 results previously inspected; chronological 2023–24 split is retrospective only, not genuinely untouched external holdout.
